messages:
ashok: FYI seeing a weird packing pattern in ap-southeast1 — lots of tiny GPU pods Pending while several warm nodes sit at <20%
lucy: heatmap? :eyes:
jordan: any recent infra jobs that touched node labels or taints?
ashok: yes, last-nightmaintenance did a rolling label reconcile. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alloc/heatmap?r=apse1 shows pods from the same cohort spread across racks. KV-cache miss rate spikes in traces.
maria: autoscaler shows we refused to spin new racks due to cost-guardrail at 03:14 UTC (commit budget consumed). we clawed back a few minutes later but by then pods were fragmented
ops-bot: scheduler-alert: 28 pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1 for >7m; symptom: affinity/label drift + taint application during drain. recommended: temporary reserve bump or enable preemptible burst for batch NSs
jordan: confirmed we applied taints `rack-maint=true:NoSchedule` to nodes in rack-7 while drain cleanup was still ongoing
kenji: quick mitigation: relax per-az reserved capacity for batch queues and allow short-lived preemptible VMs. also consider setting packing policy to preferSameRack for namespace-scoped jobs to keep KV cache hot
lucy: risk: some latency-sensitive service meshes could get preempted; need fallback routing to smaller model variants if scheduling preempts them
maria: schedule change approved for canary in apse1-a: bump reserve +10 GPUs and enable burst-preemptible for batch-namespace for 15m
ashok: triggered canary. pending dropped 28 -> 8 in 3m :thumbsup:
jordan: one straggler: pod research-job-12 still Pending due to label mismatch: pod selector gpu-type=t4 but nodes relabeled gpu_type=t4a during node image roll.
kenji: I'll push a tiny operator patch to tolerate underscore/dash label variants (gpu-type vs gpu_type) and add a reconciliation hook to map common aliases
maria: follow-ups: (1) run compaction job to coalesce small pods onto warm nodes, (2) add cohort-scatter alert to telemetry, (3) revisit cost-guardrail short-burst exceptions with finance
ashok: added runbook note: check `kubectl get nodes -L gpu-type,gpu_type` and `kubectl describe pod research-job-12` for binding errors
lucy: pending count steady <5 for 12m on dashboard, closing incident but leaving monitor for 1h
ops-bot: incident resolved: pending <5 for 10m. opened issue #infra-apse1-cohort-scatter for long-term fixes
